classification.conductor_shaped: every detected patch not satisfying all vessel rules

detection.density_threshold: the per-frame tare-floor current divided by labelled-core cell-centre area
detection.detectable_fraction: exterior L1 current in detectable patches divided by total exterior L1 current
detection.detectable_patch: absolute signed patch current exceeds the per-frame tare-floor current

eddy_signature.drive: local mean time derivative of shipped-coil total flux, using the native-rate 50 ms smoothed current derivative
eddy_signature.required_sign: signed patch current times local drive is negative

selection.rule: the exact clipped-cell tare cohort: three evenly spaced finite diverted labels from each of the first twenty lexicographic shots outside the complete 603-shot polarity population

tare.delta_star_region: valid nodes strictly outside the labelled LCFS
tare.route: landed exact clipped-cell zeroth, radial, and vertical moments
